questions.category: B5 — Use Diagnostic and Measuring Tools and Equipment
questions.question: A walk-in cooler has poor temperature pull-down. You measure suction pressure, liquid pressure, line temperatures, voltage, and amperage. Why is this better than checking only pressure?
options: Multiple readings show the full operating condition
Amperage is only useful on gas systems
questions.explanation: Refrigeration problems often require pressure, temperature, electrical, and airflow readings. Pressure alone can mislead because several faults may produce similar pressures.

questions.question: A technician uses manufacturer software to check fault history on a communicating system. What is the main benefit?
options: It identifies stored operating faults and sensor data
It eliminates the need for gauges
questions.explanation: Digital diagnostics can show fault codes, sensor values, run history, and control status. The technician still must verify readings and repair the cause.

questions.question: A schematic shows a pressure control wired in series with the compressor contactor coil. What happens if the pressure control opens?
questions.explanation: Series controls must all be closed for current to reach the coil. If one safety opens, the compressor contactor drops out.

questions.category: C3 — Use Codes, Regulations and Standards
questions.question: A technician is replacing gas piping. Which authority normally has jurisdiction over gas installation requirements?
questions.explanation: Gas installations must follow applicable codes and the authority having jurisdiction. Local rules and inspections may also apply.

questions.category: C4 — Use Manufacturer and Supplier Documentation
questions.question: A replacement TXV has the correct connection size but different refrigerant rating. What should you do?
options: Use it only for temporary operation
Select the correct valve for the refrigerant and capacity
questions.explanation: TXVs are selected by refrigerant, capacity, pressure range, and application. A valve that physically fits may still meter incorrectly.
